findings.why_not_priced: It is nine search-engine-invisible hours old and it lives only in the RNS record. If it were priced, the 09:43 UTC filing would have produced a step change in the tape rather than +0.6% retraced inside an hour; a WebSearch for the fund and the company returns the Goldman TR-1 that Reuters auto-carried and zero Irenic hits; and no UK outlet has written it up. What makes tomorrow the resolution rather than some later week is that a results morning is when eight brokers publish, the domestic press writes the company up, and management is asked on the call -- the activist gets read into the story then, not on a quiet Monday. Two things sharpen it: EQT's Rule 2.8 restriction from 25 Feb 2026 ran six months and expired 25 August 2026, and the board rejected EQT's four proposals as having 'undervalued the Company' when the stock was near 889p against 472p now.

findings.finding: Tomorrow is the first time management speaks to the Novartis/BMS autoimmune CAR-T pause, which happened after the 7 August guide -- Novartis began holding eight rap-cel trials on 24 August after three IEC-HS deaths, disclosed 1 September, and OXB fell 14.7% that day and a further 5.1% the next with no RNS of its own. The sell-side quantification is small and survivable: c.10-16m of annual clinical revenue at risk (7-10m Novartis, 2-6m BMS), autoimmune 13% of 48 programmes, and pre-booked manufacturing slots protecting FY2026 with disruption pushed to new bookings in H2 2027. Reiterating 180-200m six weeks after cutting to it is the base case and is not what the 1-2 September tape priced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance is the line that has moved this stock all year and it has moved it down: -14.6% on 7 Aug 2026 when FY26 went from 220-240m to 180-200m (591 to 505 on 6.6m shares), and -5.12% on the 26 Mar 2026 prelims. OXB has not had a positive scheduled-release reaction in the observed record, which is why this is sized as a relief rather than a re-rating.
findings.original_quote: the scale of OXB's share price decline looked overdone, given the company's already depressed valuation and the breadth of its pipeline ... autoimmune indications made up only 13% of OXB's 48 programmes as of April 2025
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is 472p against 524p on 28 August, so roughly half the Novartis/BMS drawdown is still in the price six weeks on, and the company has said nothing -- its RNS record between 14 August and today contains one Total Voting Rights notice and four Holding(s) in Company, no trading statement. If the market believed FY26 was protected by pre-booked slots it would have closed the 1-2 September gap. Against it: the cell-and-gene CDMO sector is in genuine retrenchment (Rentschler withdrawing, Catalent closing Belgium, Charles River divesting its CDMO to GI Partners, Lonza reporting softer cell-and-gene), which is a broader public series and is the reason the low end of my band is -3.5 rather than -1.
findings.independence: Net of the rest of the company: for the 180-200m guide to hold, H2 must deliver 100-120m against H1's 80m, i.e. +25% to +50% half-on-half, with the Durham NC site ramping on its revised schedule. Corroborated from the issuer's own document rather than a broker -- 193m revenue backlog and 97m of contracted client orders at 30 June, 17 new clients in H1 (more than 30% above the whole of FY25): https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/oxford-biomedica--oxb/half-year-trading-update-and-notice-of-results/9709646

So the crowd is many books each under 0.5% -- a quant and dealer profile rather than one fundamental bear -- and it is invisible on the screens a UK private investor or adviser actually looks at.

The FCA aggregate says 6.86% and building; the per-holder file that Investegate, and every retail short screen downstream of it, mirrors says zero. A market that had reconciled them would not leave a 2.4x build since the profit warning unremarked in every piece of coverage I could find. I have deliberately NOT sized this as though it were an independent bear signal -- see independence.
findings.independence: NOT independent of finding 1 and sized down for it. outside_window.finding: EQT's Rule 2.8 restriction from its 25 February 2026 'no intention to make an offer' announcement ran six months and expired on 25 August 2026, so the bidder whose four proposals the board rejected as having 'undervalued the Company' -- when the shares were near 889p against 472p now -- is free to return, and an activist with a stated sale playbook has just appeared on the register. A renewed approach, a Rule 2.4 announcement or a public Irenic letter is the fat right tail on this name and it will almost certainly not land in one session.

The cell-and-gene CDMO capacity shake-out -- Rentschler withdrawing from cell and gene, Catalent closing its Belgian cell therapy centre, Charles River divesting its CDMO and Cell Solutions to GI Partners, Lonza reporting softer cell-and-gene -- removes competing capacity and is the medium-term bull case for OXB's 2027 25-30% growth guide, but nothing about it settles on 22 September.

lessons_applied: DROPPED the -0.3 financing finding outright. 'Financing is a question, not a verdict -- ask what the money buys and whether backlog, bookings, inventory or hiring corroborate a ramp.' Keeping a negative I had already argued myself out of would have been exactly the 'finding whose own text argues against it' failure. The tight 21m net cash now sits in conviction_note as a reason the upside is not larger.
